checks.sql: select string_agg(r.rolname || ':' || (has_table_privilege(r.rolname, 'public.collection_posts', 'SELECT'))::text || ':' || (select string_agg(a.attname, ',' order by a.attname) from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid = 'public.collection_posts'::regclass and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped and has_column_privilege(r.rolname, 'public.collection_posts', a.attname, 'SELECT')), ' | ' order by r.rolname) from pg_roles r where r.rolname in ('anon', 'authenticated')
